title: This Claude Update Replaces n8n and Make #claude #automation #aitools
description:
Big Claude updates news! Re-organised desktop app, new Claude Code features and Opus 4.7 smashing the benchmarks again. Anthropic have shipped at their usual pace this week with some great new upgrades to Claude. The most interesting one is Routines - like scheduled tasks but more powerful, work in the cloud and can be used to build automations, potentially replacing things like n8n and make.
#claude #anthropic #AI #artificialintelligence #tech #technology #learnontiktok
